description: Create school- and district-level administrative tools for K-12 leaders: classroom walkthrough instruments, initiative implementation plans, and progress-monitoring / data systems. Use this whenever a principal, assistant principal, or district leader needs leadership tools — phrasings like 'a walkthrough form for our focus on…', 'an implementation plan for rolling out…', 'how do we monitor whether…is working', or 'a school-wide plan for…'. It builds focused walkthrough look-fors tied to a clear initiative, structures rollouts with phases / roles / milestones, and defines what data will show progress. Make sure to use this whenever the scope is school- or system-level implementation and monitoring. Do NOT use it for non-evaluative teacher coaching/PD (professional-learning) or for individual classroom lessons (lesson-planner) — this skill operates at the school/system level.
